## Overview

Initial eager PCP × DP microbatch composition for MRV2, tracking #64351. **Draft: static review, CPU unit tests and single-GPU component tests only. No model was loaded, and distributed model correctness is not qualified.**

## Claims

- Partition with the existing PCP manager, split each rank's local rows at the existing DBO midpoint, merge DBO outputs before the PCP restore, and keep the original sampling batch.
- Split only when the first microbatch holds a causal prefix of every request across all PCP ranks, reusing the existing DP handshake. DP ranks with different PCP-local token counts keep the unsplit path, so DP padding cannot move the checked midpoint.
- Slice PCP request metadata and rank-major gathered slot mappings; size the runner by the PCP input-buffer request capacity.
- Allow PCP+DBO only for `--enable-dbo`, NIXL EP with DP>1 and expert parallelism, TP=1, DCP=1, no speculative decoding, synchronous scheduling and no CUDA graphs. Attention backends that do not support PCP are already rejected at backend selection.

## Validation

| Check | Result |
| --- | --- |
| `tests/test_config.py -k 'pcp_dbo or dbo'` | **11 passed** |
| `test_gpu_dp_utils.py`, `test_gpu_pcp_manager.py`, `test_gpu_ubatch_slicing.py` on CPU | **133 passed**, 15 skipped; 3 existing `test_parallel_config_manages_decode_sharding` cases fail locally because `ray` is not installed |
| Same three files on one H200, no model weights | **148 passed, 0 skipped**; the same 3 `ray` cases fail |
| Ruff check/format, `git diff --check` | Passed |
| mypy on the five production files | Same errors as main, none new |
| Real PCP2 × DP2 model run | **Not run** |
| Performance | **Not measured** |

```bash
VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER=1 pytest -q tests/test_config.py -k 'pcp_dbo or dbo'
VLLM_TARGET_DEVICE=cpu VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER=1 pytest -q --noconftest \
    tests/v1/worker/test_gpu_dp_utils.py tests/v1/worker/test_gpu_pcp_manager.py \
    tests/v1/worker/test_gpu_ubatch_slicing.py
```

`tests/v1/worker` is selected by the `V1 Executor + Worker` CI step and `tests/test_config.py` by `Engine Core`.

## Details

Production change: **+114/-8**. There is no new collective, runner, KV allocator or publication protocol. Decode-only batches and dummy/profile runs keep the ordinary unsplit PCP path. The rendered DBO docs describe the scope.

Duplicate checks searched #64351 and PCP/DBO keywords and read the issue comments. No open PR for this composition was found. #61464 addresses speculative decoding/DCP; #52863 provides PCP KV publication and barrier lanes; neither composes PCP partitioning with the MRV2 ubatch runner as here.

Before readiness: human review of every changed line, real PCP2 × DP2 outputs/logprobs and collective ordering, request reuse/imbalance, and performance/memory qualification. AI assistance was used for implementation, review and testing.

@@ -41,6 +41,33 @@ EX: `vllm serve deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V2-Lite --trust-remote-code --data-parallel
 
 Note that there must be at least two GPUs visible in `CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES`
 
+### Experimental eager PCP + DBO in Model Runner V2
+
+!!! warning "Draft implementation"
+    This has static review and component tests only. Multi-GPU model outputs
+    and performance have not been qualified.
+
+MRV2 supports DBO with prefill context parallelism for NIXL EP, DP+EP, TP=1,
+DCP=1, no speculative decoding, synchronous scheduling and eager execution.
+Set `VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER=1` and pass `--enforce-eager` and
+`--no-async-scheduling`. The attention backend must support PCP.
+
+PCP partitions the scheduled batch first; DBO then splits each rank's local
+rows at the existing midpoint. A step is split only when:
+
+- It contains a prefill, meets the DBO thresholds and every DP rank votes to
+  split.
+- Across all PCP ranks, the first microbatch holds a causal prefix of every
+  request, so no early query needs KV from the second microbatch.
+- Every DP rank has the same PCP-local token count, since DP padding would
+  move the checked midpoint.
+
+Other steps, including decode-only batches and dummy runs, use the ordinary
+PCP forward. Each PCP rank derives its count and vote from the same scheduler
+layout, so the existing DP handshake agrees across the whole DP x PCP expert
+group. The DBO merge restores the local row order before the PCP restore and a
+single sampling pass over the original batch.
+
 ## DBO Components
 
 * GPUModelRunner
